{{Quote|The ''Halcyon'' is a ''Purgill''-class ''[sic]'' with thirteen engines.|[[Rodor Keen]]|<ref name="The High Republic: Mission to Disaster">''[[The High Republic: Mission to Disaster]]''</ref>}}
'''''Purrgil''-class starcruisers'''<ref name="Galactic Starcruiser">[[Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser|''Star Wars'': Galactic Starcruiser]]</ref> were passenger liners operated by [[Chandrila Star Line]]. They were some of the first commercial vessels to offer [[hyperdrive]] travel.<ref name="Overview" /> A model of ''Purrgil''-class starcruiser was the [[MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser|MPO-1400]],<ref name="Midnight Horizon">''[[The High Republic: Midnight Horizon]]''</ref> also known as the Chandrilan Class I<ref name="Galaxy's Edge">[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]]</ref> designed by [[Shug Drabor]]<ref name="Midnight Horizon">''[[The High Republic: Midnight Horizon]]''</ref> which included the famed luxury ship ''[[Halcyon]]''.<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=disney-parks-experiences-and-products-reveals-new-magic-at-d23-expo-2019|text=Disney Parks, Experiences and Products Reveals New Magic at D23 Expo 2019}}</ref>

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
These ships were first mentioned as background information about Chandrila Star Line, the operator of the ''[[Halcyon]]'' starship from [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney's]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser|''Star Wars'': Galactic Starcruiser]].<ref name="Overview" />
